title: Affine projection duality on closed supports
statement: Fix a universe u, a prime ell and a field k of positive characteristic different from ell. All schemes are separated finite-type k-schemes in u. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring with a certificate IsEllAdicCoefficient ell Lambda, allowing continuous finite extensions, integral valuation rings with torsion, and the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. Write B_T for the full bounded constructible subcategory of the ordinary unbounded derived category of internal Lambda_T-module objects [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible; sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let Y be such a scheme and n a finite type in u. Write A=A^n_Y and p:A -> Y. For every K in B_Y there exists P in B_A, independent of the support, such that for every closed immersion i:U -> A with exact module pushforward and every compactification c of i;p there are equivalences e_M:Hom(R(i;p)!_c M,K) ~= Hom(D(i_*)M,P) for all M in B_U. They satisfy e_M(R(i;p)!_c(a);b)=D(i_*)(a);e_N(b) for every a:M -> N and b:R(i;p)!_c N -> K.

proof.text: Obtain the bounded constructible representative P and the natural projection Hom equivalences on ambient affine-space tests. This object is independent of any later closed support.

For a closed immersion i, use compactification independence, composition, and the proper comparison Ri! ~= Ri_* to identify compact support of i;p with projection compact support after closed pushforward. Include the bounded constructible functor isomorphism into the ambient derived category. Exact closed pushforward identifies Ri_* with D(i_*).

Transport the projection Hom equivalences along these two natural isomorphisms. A generic categorical transport_representability lemma proves the naturality identity, applying the naturality squares of both comparison isomorphisms and of the original projection equivalences. No adjoint is chosen, and no new geometric assumption is introduced.

theorem affine_projection_closedSupport_duality (n : Type u) [Finite n]
    (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory) :
    let A : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk ((𝔸(n; Y.left) ↘ Y.left) ≫ Y.hom)
    let p : A ⟶ Y := Over.homMk (𝔸(n; Y.left) ↘ Y.left) rfl
    ∃ P : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ A.left)).FullSubcategory,
      ∀ {U : Over (Spec (.of k))}
        [LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom] [QuasiCompact U.hom] [IsSeparated U.hom]
        (i : U ⟶ A) [IsClosedImmersion i.left]
        [PreservesFiniteColimits ((i.left)_*⟦Λ⟧)]
        (c : Compactification (i ≫ p).left),
        ∃ e : ∀ M : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ U.left)).FullSubcategory,
          ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c).obj M.obj ⟶ K.obj) ≃
            (D((i.left)_*⟦Λ⟧).obj M.obj ⟶ P.obj),
          ∀ (M N : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ U.left)).FullSubcategory)
            (a : M.obj ⟶ N.obj)
            (b : (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c).obj N.obj ⟶ K.obj),
            e M ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c).map a ≫ b) =
              D((i.left)_*⟦Λ⟧).map a ≫ e N b
